# The channel's own limit on an external link in a post

## Statement
The destination's published policy limits where an external link may appear in a
channel post. A post that places one elsewhere is refused by the platform, not
merely shown to fewer readers.

## Applies when
destination is telegram

## Influences
- S-10 · `E-14.cross_destination_link` — where the cross-destination link goes.

## Conflicts
None known.

## Source
A fixture record for the knowledge loader: a hard platform rule whose review has
lapsed, so that §5's asymmetry has something to be read from.
